description: This PHP class 'InstallHelper' provides methods for importing, processing, and managing default content in a Drupal module, including handling multilingual content, creating entities, and managing references between taxonomy terms, media, nodes, and users.

classes.name: InstallHelper
classes.description: Helper class for importing default content into a Drupal site, managing entities, multilingual content, and references.

methods.name: importContent
methods.description: Main method to import various content types such as users, taxonomy terms, media, nodes, and blocks.

methods.name: getModulePath
methods.description: Sets the module path based on the module handler.

methods.name: readMultilingualContent
methods.description: Reads multilingual CSV content files for a given filename and returns content and language list.

methods.name: getTermId
methods.description: Retrieves the stored term ID for a given vocabulary and CSV ID.

methods.name: saveTermId
methods.description: Stores a term ID associated with a vocabulary and CSV ID.

methods.name: getMediaImageId
methods.description: Retrieves the stored media image ID for a given CSV ID.

methods.name: saveMediaImageId
methods.description: Stores a media image ID associated with a CSV ID.

methods.name: getNodePath
methods.description: Retrieves the node URL path for a given language, content type, and CSV ID.

methods.name: saveNodePath
methods.description: Stores the node URL path for a given language, content type, and CSV ID.

methods.name: importUsers
methods.description: Creates default user accounts with specific roles and preferred languages.

methods.name: processTerm
methods.description: Prepares taxonomy term data for import.

methods.name: processImage
methods.description: Prepares image media entity data for import.

methods.name: processPage
methods.description: Prepares page node data for import.

methods.name: processRecipe
methods.description: Prepares recipe node data for import, including images, categories, and instructions.

methods.name: processArticle
methods.description: Prepares article node data for import.

methods.name: processBannerBlock
methods.description: Prepares banner block data for import.

methods.name: processDisclaimerBlock
methods.description: Prepares disclaimer block data for import.

methods.name: processFooterPromoBlock
methods.description: Prepares footer promo block data for import.

methods.name: processContent
methods.description: Dispatches content processing based on bundle type.

methods.name: importContentFromFile
methods.description: Imports content entities from CSV files, handling multilingual translations.

methods.name: deleteImportedContent
methods.description: Deletes all content entities imported by this module based on stored UUIDs.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a user by name.

methods.name: createFileEntity
methods.description: Creates a file entity from an image path.

methods.name: storeCreatedContentUuids
methods.description: Records UUIDs of created entities for later reference or deletion.
